invariants.rationale: Method throws an exception if operationType equals LOG_COMPACT, so it's always not LOG_COMPACT at exit.
table is used for method calls and field accesses, so must not be null.
pendingCompactionTimeline is used for method calls, so must not be null.
operationType is compared using .equals(), so it must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
instantTime is passed to methods and thus must not be null.
